relationships.subject: beta-caryophyllene
relationships.evidence_quote: BCP showed an appreciable interaction pattern in the orthosteric pocket of CB2 with a binding energy of −7.83 kJ/mol and Ki of 1.81 µM.

key_findings: Viphyllin (black pepper extract, >=30% BCP) is antinociceptive in mouse writhing, formalin, hot plate and tail flick tests.
Antagonist reversal and docking implicate CB2, PPARα and TRPV1 in the effect.
